title: Save Ring
description: A download button for Abbey Road. Press it and the pill folds into a ring that fills with the cover as the songs come in, one by one, then floods the disc and draws a check. Tap the ring mid-download and it unwinds; tap again and it picks up where it was.
intent: A music-app save control finished to the edge, interruptible both ways, with one over-the-top flourish: the progress ring is made of the cover art.
